verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a note-taking and knowledge app, but the evidence shows no built-in scheduler or recurring-workflow feature. Daily notes only opens or creates today's note when invoked, which is an adjacent feature. Headless Sync and the Obsidian URI scheme could be triggered by a user's own external cron (a user-side workaround). The plugin API is a developer building block, not a scheduling capability. None of these earn credit.
